title: Strum
description: Recently played song titles set as a type scale and strung like a harp — sweep across the lines to strum them, or pull one down and let it twang. Every string tuned an octave or a fifth away shivers in sympathy, so dragging the ratio from a major third to a perfect fifth changes how much of the waterfall answers you.
intent: Make the type law audible: every size is a string, the letters bend and thicken where you pull, and the ratio between sizes is the chord you hear.
